recommendations.body: `RoadmapSourceAdmission` and `RunLogWriter.roadmap_source_admission()` in `plan_tool/run_log.py` (step 2 “Persist and check brief digests before artifact admission”) expose `disposition` as an unconstrained `str`, although the lifecycle contract requires a closed producer-owned disposition vocabulary; downstream type consumers cannot rely on the documented set
recommendations.suggested_action: define and use a `Literal` admission-disposition type for the event field and writer parameter

recommendations.body: `TestInputsAndSeams` in `tests/test_roadmap.py` and `test_roadmap_lifecycle_events_capture_effects_without_source_text()` in `tests/test_run_log.py` (step 2 “Persist and check brief digests before artifact admission”) cover changed and legacy refusals but do not prove malformed metadata or a directory `source.json` emits `refused-malformed` before any brief read, nor that every disposition emits exactly one decision before artifact work
recommendations.suggested_action: add parametrized admission-ordering and malformed-directory regression tests plus closed-disposition serialization coverage
